_note: Résumé template registry. Add a template = drop an HTML file in this dir + an entry here. All are single-column, real-text, ATS-safe clean-room designs (not copied from any provider). tailor-resume lists these and renders the user's pick.

templates.name: Classic
templates.style: Centered header, ruled UPPERCASE headings, company-left/location-right, italic titles/dates, bold metrics. Mirrors a Word-style résumé. Most conservative — safest ATS.

templates.name: Zenith
templates.style: Modern navy name + left-bar headings, carries the same classic structure. Tech-forward. PDF reading-order ATS-verified.

templates.name: The Ledger
templates.style: Minimal, one teal accent, monospace date-ledger, hairline left spine. Distinctive/editorial.
